% Pages of a PDF included with pdfpages, each converted to a picture: the
% page shows the pages the PDF shows, in its order. The PDFs in
% test-pdfpages/ have pages of different widths and labels ("four 1"), so
% each picture names its page. Each run starts with a paragraph "Run name."
% \includepdf with every page (pages=-), a closed range, an open end, an
% open start, the last page, a reversed range, last to the first page, a
% blank page in a list (no picture), a list with repeats and the last page,
% a list, one page, no pages option (page 1), the name with .pdf, a PDF
% found through \graphicspath, \includepdfmerge with a range for each
% document, doublepages, duplicatepages, a lastpage hint, openright (a
% blank page, no picture), and \includepdfset{pages=-}. With hyperref;
% test-pdfpages-plain has the same pages without it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pdfpages}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\graphicspath{{test-pdfpages/sub/}}
\begin{document}
\section{Included pages}
Run dash.
\includepdf[pages=-]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run closed.
\includepdf[pages={1-3}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run open end.
\includepdf[pages={3-}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run open start.
\includepdf[pages={-2}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run last.
\includepdf[pages=last]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run reversed.
\includepdf[pages={4-2}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run last to first.
\includepdf[pages={last-1}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run blank.
\includepdf[pages={1,{},4}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run repeats.
\includepdf[pages={2,last,1-2}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run list.
\includepdf[pages={3,1}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run one.
\includepdf[pages=2]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run default.
\includepdf{test-pdfpages/four}

Run extension.
\includepdf[pages=-]{test-pdfpages/four.pdf}

Run graphicspath.
\includepdf[pages=-]{three}

Run merge.
\includepdfmerge{test-pdfpages/four,2-3,test-pdfpages/two,-}

Run doublepages.
\includepdf[pages={1-2},doublepages]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run duplicatepages.
\includepdf[pages={2-3},duplicatepages=3]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run lastpage.
\includepdf[pages=-,lastpage=2]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run openright.
\includepdf[pages={1-2},openright]{test-pdfpages/two}

Run set.
\includepdfset{pages=-}
\includepdf{test-pdfpages/two}

Run end.
\end{document}
